Shortlist 3 to 5 repos from today's imported GitHub Trending feed for review @people-self @place-anywhere @tools-github @when-sod-personal-pre-training
DESCRIPTION: Open the Todoist project populated by the daily GitHub Trending sync, then pick 3 to 5 repos for today's review batch.

CONTENT: 2️⃣ Quick triage - fit and quality checks
Check the README opening clearly states purpose, audience, and value @people-self @place-anywhere @tools-github @when-sod-personal-pre-training
DESCRIPTION: Pass if the opening lines explain what the project does, who it is for, and the main value or problem it addresses.

CONTENT: Check the README includes quick start install and run steps plus one runnable example @people-self @place-anywhere @tools-github @when-sod-personal-pre-training
DESCRIPTION: Pass if the README includes prerequisites, an install step, a run step, and one concrete usage example with expected output or outcome.

CONTENT: Assess repo traction using star count and trending momentum @people-self @place-anywhere @tools-github @when-sod-personal-pre-training
DESCRIPTION: Pass if stars are increasing in the trending feed (day-over-day) or if the repo has gained at least 20 stars in the last 7 days. Lower total star counts are acceptable when momentum is clearly upward.

CONTENT: Confirm the repository language and stack align with your focus areas @people-self @place-anywhere @tools-github @when-sod-personal-pre-training
DESCRIPTION: Review the repository's primary language, framework, and core dependencies to confirm alignment with your focus areas (such as work stack, learning goals, or active projects).

CONTENT: Validate that licence terms allow your intended use and distribution @people-self @place-anywhere @tools-github @when-sod-personal-pre-training
DESCRIPTION: Pass if the licence permits your intended use (such as commercial use, modification, and redistribution) and does not introduce obligations you cannot meet.

CONTENT: 3️⃣ Deep Review - health and maintainability checks
Check project health using commit activity, issue handling, maintainer responsiveness, and roadmap updates @people-self @place-anywhere @tools-github @when-sod-personal-pre-training
DESCRIPTION: Review recent commit activity, issue response quality, maintainer follow-through, and roadmap updates to decide whether the project shows active, reliable maintenance.

CONTENT: Assign one action to each repo: Star or Watch or Reference or Ignore @people-self @place-anywhere @tools-github @when-sod-personal-pre-training
DESCRIPTION: Ensure every reviewed repo has a clear outcome assigned: Star to bookmark for later use, Watch to follow updates, Reference to note for a specific purpose, or Ignore to dismiss.

CONTENT: Add starred or watched repos to your tracking project @people-self @place-anywhere @tools-github @when-sod-personal-pre-training
DESCRIPTION: For any repo assigned Star or Watch today add it to your GitHub Trending Tracker project with a note on why it is worth following.
